about.headline: Design, code & motion under one roof
about.intro: **SaifurHub** is a creative digital studio founded by Saifur Rahman in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
about.story: It started with freelance logo, t-shirt and web projects for clients around the world. Today SaifurHub is a small team of designers, developers, video editors and motion designers working together, so you get your **website, graphics and videos from one place**, in one consistent style.

highlights.title: Design first
highlights.description: Every project starts with research and design: layouts, typography and colours that fit your brand.

highlights.title: Built to last
highlights.description: Fast, responsive websites built with modern tools like React, Next.js and Node.js, easy to grow later.

highlights.title: Motion that stands out
highlights.description: Video edits, motion graphics and animations that make your brand stand out on social media.

services.title: Website Development
services.description: Fast, responsive websites and full-stack web apps built with React, Next.js, Node.js and MongoDB, from landing pages to complete platforms.

services.title: UI / UX Design
services.description: Clear, user-friendly interfaces and clickable prototypes designed in Figma, so your product looks great and is easy to use on every screen.

services.title: Graphic Design
services.description: Eye-catching posters, flyers, social media posts, logos and t-shirt designs, with strong typography and print-ready files.

services.title: Video Editing
services.description: Reels, promos, YouTube videos and ads edited with clean cuts, colour grading, sound design, subtitles and smooth transitions.

services.title: Motion Graphics
services.description: Animated titles, logo reveals, lower thirds and explainer graphics that make your videos and brand feel alive.

services.title: Animation
services.description: Animated social posts, ads and website animations, taken from idea and storyboard to the final render.

testimonials.name: Alex Morgan
testimonials.content: Saifur delivered an exceptional e-commerce platform for us. His attention to design detail, clean code structure, and lightning-fast responsiveness blew our team away.

testimonials.name: Sarah Jenkins
testimonials.content: Working with Saifur on our brand identity and custom logo system was seamless. He blends creative design intuition with professional execution effortlessly.

testimonials.name: David K.
testimonials.content: Absolute professional on Upwork! Completed our web app project ahead of schedule with top-tier React architecture and beautiful Tailwind styling.

testimonials.name: new_brute
testimonials.content: Saif is a total gentleman and works really hard. I am very busy and takes a long time for me to make decisions. He was fine with that and extending his delivery date for me, always quick with his adjustments and patient with my thinking time. He also took time to explain to me how I could adjust colors etc myself with Adobe, which meant I didn’t have to have him find the perfect colour combination, I can try those myself! :) I’ll work with him again. He was great FIVE STARS all round.

testimonials.name: ctcreativemedia.
testimonials.content: Excellent work by Saif! He was patient with me and stayed in constant communication which is super important to me when I hire someone. He has an eye for creativity that can't be found just anywhere. I went with the highest tier he offers and it was worth it. Will work with again!.
